batch_1.sbatch.text:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=ec_endpoint_pair
#SBATCH --partition=hpxg
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --array=0-1%1
#SBATCH --no-requeue
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%A_%a.out
set -euo pipefail
module load openmpi/5.0
source "$HOME/project/soft/orca/env.sh"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
test "${SLURM_NTASKS}" = 4
cd "${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR}"
sha256sum -c PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS
task=$(sed -n "$((SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID + 1))p" batch_1.txt)
test -n "$task"
cd "$task"
sha256sum -c inputs.sha256
baseline_dir="$HOME/project/electrolyte_wp2/$(cat baseline_relative.txt)"
baseline_hash=$(cat baseline_gbw_hash.txt)
mkdir -p attempts
run_dir="attempts/${SLURM_ARRAY_JOB_ID}_${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}_${SLURM_RESTART_COUNT:-0}"
mkdir "$run_dir"
cp geom.xyz job.inp "$run_dir/"
cd "$run_dir"
mkdir mpi_tmp baseline_vt
export TMPDIR="$PWD/mpi_tmp"
export PRTE_MCA_prte_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR" PMIX_MCA_pmix_tmpdir_base="$TMPDIR"
# Baseline is copied read-only in intent; old attempt files are never modified.
cp "$baseline_dir/job_freq.gbw" baseline_vt/job_freq.gbw
cp "$baseline_dir/geom.xyz" baseline_vt/geom.xyz
cmp geom.xyz baseline_vt/geom.xyz
printf '%s  baseline_vt/job_freq.gbw\n' "$baseline_hash" | sha256sum -c -
# No old MO is placed at job.gbw: this new SCF starts cold.
"$ORCA_DIR/orca" job.inp > job.log 2> job.stderr
grep -q 'ORCA TERMINATED NORMALLY' job.log
test -s job.engrad
"$ORCA_DIR/orca_2mkl" job -molden > molden_export.out 2> molden_export.err
test -s job.molden.input
cd baseline_vt
"$ORCA_DIR/orca_2mkl" job_freq -molden > export.out 2> export.err
test -s job_freq.molden.input
cd ..
sha256sum geom.xyz job.inp job.log job.engrad job.gbw job.molden.input baseline_vt/job_freq.gbw baseline_vt/job_freq.molden.input > OUTPUT_SHA256SUMS
